glosses: im Verhältnis der Abstände der Realität entsprechend

translations.source_sense_description: im Verhältnis der Abstände der Realität entsprechend

glosses: Drawn, designed or constructed such that each dimension has the same proportion to the original.

examples.text: The one-metre-long model of the Bismarck was built exactly to scale, with moving turrets.
Maps of the solar system are often not drawn to scale due to the vast distances between the planets.
